model_annotation: The figure presents two line plots comparing the training rewards of two models, Llama-On-Policy and Llama-LUFFY, across different training sets. The top plot, titled "Easy Training Set," illustrates the training rewards on the y-axis against the number of steps on the x-axis, which ranges from 0 to 500. The rewards are measured on a scale from 0.0 to 0.4. The Llama-On-Policy-Easy (teal line) and Llama-LUFFY-Easy (red line) models show similar trends, with both starting near a reward of 0.0 and increasing to a plateau near 0.4. The Llama-LUFFY-Easy model generally achieves slightly higher rewards, particularly after 100 steps, and exhibits more variability. The bottom plot, titled "Hard Training Set," shows a similar comparison with rewards on the y-axis ranging from 0.0 to 0.2 and steps on the x-axis also ranging from 0 to 500. In this case, the Llama-On-Policy-Hard (teal line) model starts at a reward of 0.0 and remains flat at 0.0 until around 100 steps, then increases to a peak of approximately 0.12 before declining and fluctuating. The Llama-LUFFY-Hard (red line) model starts at a reward of 0.0, increases rapidly to a peak of about 0.18, and then fluctuates around 0.15. The Llama-LUFFY-Hard model consistently achieves higher rewards than the Llama-On-Policy-Hard model across the entire training process.
